## WireInteger type

An integer, carried as canonical decimal text.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type WireInteger = {
  readonly integer: string
}
```

## Remarks

The payload matches `^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$`<!-- -->: no sign on zero, no leading zeros, no `+`<!-- -->. Its magnitude must lie within the SDK integer domain.
